title: Annotatio V §.II: teeth vs heart; sacramento tenus vs really; members unto Spirit; visible sacrament vs virtue
pass_a_gloss: To press carnally and visibly with the teeth the Sacrament of Christ’s body and blood, and Spiritually to eat His flesh and drink His blood — City of God bk. 21 ch. 15. As far as the Sacrament, to eat Christ’s Body and drink His blood, and really to eat Christ’s body and drink His blood. In Joh. tract. 26: to eat Christ’s body by the Sacrament, and in the thing itself to eat Christ’s Body. To eat bread outside, and to eat bread inside. To press bread with the tooth, and to eat bread in the heart, ibid. In the Sacrament to eat Christ’s Flesh and drink Christ’s Blood, and in Joh. tract. 27 to eat Christ’s flesh and drink His Blood unto participation of the Spirit, that we may remain in the Lord’s body as members. In Joh. tract. 26: some pertain to the visible Sacrament and some to the Sacrament’s virtue; that the Sacrament is one thing and Christ’s Body and Blood another — to Januarius’s inquiry ch. 3 — which visible food is one thing, the Sacrament another (Joh. tract. 26), the Sacrament’s virtue another (Psal. 77) according to which the heavenly bread is said to be eaten spiritually — against Max. bk. 3 ch. 12.
pass_b_english: Teeth press the sacrament carnally/visibly vs spiritually eat flesh and drink blood (City of God 21.15). Sacramento tenus vs really; by sacrament vs in the thing itself; bread outside vs inside; tooth vs heart.

Eat unto Spirit-participation so we remain members in the Lord’s body. Some belong to the visible sacrament, some to its virtue — visible food / sacrament / virtue distinguished; heavenly bread eaten spiritually (Psal. 77).
source_text: Carnaliter & visibiliter premere dentibus Sacramentum corporis & sanguinis Christi, & Spiritualiter manducare carnem ejus & bibere sanguinem ejus, de civitat. Dei lib. 21. cap. 15. Sacramento tenus, Corpus Christi manducare & sanguinem ejus bibere, & revera corpus Christi manducare & sanguinem ejus bibere. In Johan. tractat. 26. Sacramento corpus Christi manducare, & reipsâ Corpus Christi manducare. Manducare panem foris, & manducare panem intus. Premere panem dente, & manducare panem in corde, ibid. In Sacramento Carnem Christi edere, & Sanguinem Christi bibere, & in Johan. tract. 27. usque ad Spiritus participationem carnem Christi edere & Sanguinem ejus bibere, ut in Domini corpore tanquam membra maneamus. In Johan. tract. 26. quosdam pertinere ad visibile Sacramentum & quosdam pertinere ad virtutem Sacramenti, aliud esse Sacramentum, & Corpus & Sanguinem Christi, ad inquisit. Januarii cap. 3. qui visibilis est cibus, aliud esse Sacramentum in Johan. tract. 26. aliud virtutem Sacramenti in Psal. 77 secundum quam dicitur panis cælestis spiritualiter manducari, contra Max. lib. 3. cap. 12.
